usage_guide.step_1: User types any prompt from prompt.txt in index.html input field
usage_guide.step_2: System checks prompt_mapping for exact match (case-insensitive)
usage_guide.step_3: If found, retrieves core response from core_v19_5.js logicLibrary
usage_guide.step_4: For prompts with arrays, randomly selects 1 of 10 answers
usage_guide.step_5: For single-string prompts, returns exact response
usage_guide.step_6: If no match, falls back to Gemini API for dynamic response
usage_guide.step_7: Answer displays in Neural Log Stream + Answer Box
usage_guide.step_8: Voice synthesis speaks only the answer (strips log markers)
